rationales.styles.minCorpus: Synthetic bench fixture: the corpus has only a handful of files, below the default minCorpus of 20, so the threshold is lowered to 5 to exercise the style detectors. Test-only; does not reflect production guidance.

knownMisses.reason: inferScaleStep picks step=2 which always wins ties; all remainders fall within 1px tolerance. Off-scale detection is a known algorithmic limitation.

description: Tests for the Styles analyzer — all 7 detectors: value-drift (color + exact), undefined-class, token-bypass, mechanism-fragmentation, mechanism-mixing, declaration-set-similarity, z-index-sprawl, and z-index-singleton. Off-scale is a known miss (algorithmic limitation).
